For two years we had the privilege of having our Luz at the Pelos Patudos daycare.

Luz doesn't need to speak for us to know how much she loves daycare. Wednesdays have become a special day for her and for us too, seeing how happy and restless she gets when she sees her school bag at the door, and during the walk to daycare.

Throughout the day, they share photos and videos, allowing us to follow the various activities and games they do.

We also recommend the bathing and hygienic grooming service.

The shop is very well stocked with all kinds of toys, accessories and food.

Finally, a thank you to the whole team for being so attentive to the animals and their owners.

Thank you!

I want to express my sincerest admiration for the excellent quality of services provided by PELOS PATUDOS. The way you care for pets is simply incredible!

From day one, and it's been several years now, my experience has been exceptional. The team is extremely professional, attentive, and caring with my pets. The environment is clean, safe, and cozy, making my pets feel at home.

Communication is clear and transparent, always keeping me informed and sending videos so I can follow my pets' progress. Furthermore, the activities and games offered are fun and stimulating, ensuring my pet has a day full of joy.

I recommend PELOS PATUDOS daycare to anyone looking for a safe, loving, and professional place to leave their pet. Thank you so much for everything!

Pelos Patudos has been with us since 2021 and we wouldn't trade them for anything!

The love of our animals is something inexplicable, and experiencing it with prepared, specialized, and dedicated teams makes it an extraordinary experience!

Feeling the happiness of our dogs when they go to daycare or the sense of family and home during their stays is something that is not easily found. Fortunately, for us and our two (large) dogs, we found Pelos Patudos, who over the years have dedicated time and love to our dogs as if they were their own.

In addition to all the options for training, daycare, and boarding, they also have a super-equipped and specialized shop for all the needs of our animals!

The grooming service is excellent and remarkably knowledgeable about the needs of each animal.

All the staff are remarkably kind and friendly to us humans, and with the animals, it's beyond words...

We highly recommend them!

Pelos Patudos is our dogs' second home!

Thanks!
